objectives.title: Collect Tributes
objectives.description: The Raven Lord will create Tributes periodically. Gather them for your team!

objectives.title: Curse Your Enemies
objectives.description: Upon capturing three Tributes, the Raven Lord will curse your enemies!

objectives.title: Cursed Forts and Minions
objectives.description: Cursed Structures will not attack, and cursed Minions are reduced to 1 Health.
